She lifts one record from a crate while stepping across a shallow puddle. A fitted graphite top contrasts with lightweight olive harem trousers: one gathered waistband releases substantial fabric into both trouser legs; the seat and crotch remain visibly roomy beneath the waistband during her forward step; loose folds preserve pronounced volume through both hips and thighs; multiple folds converge separately into two narrow gathered ankle cuffs; the gathered cuffs distinguish the silhouette from straight wide legs and smooth balloon hems at both ankles. A full-length, low eye-level frame leaves clear breathing room beneath both translucent jelly sandals. Keep the waist, seat, two outer-leg contours, both cuffs, and footwear visible together in a diagonal stance. Cool diffused dawn ambient light separates the olive folds from wet concrete, while amber stall bulbs edge her silhouette.
